params.name: dbentries
params.description: One or more KEGG entry identifiers, separated by plus signs. Maximum 10 entries per request. Format: database:id (e.g., hsa:10458, cpd:C01290, path:hsa00010).

items.docs: Retrieve one or more KEGG database entries in their default flat-file format. Up to 10 entries can be retrieved in a single request by separating identifiers with plus signs (e.g., hsa:10458+ece:Z5100).

info.name: Retrieve database entries in a specific format

params.name: dbentries
params.description: One or more KEGG entry identifiers separated by plus signs. Maximum 10 entries per request.

items.docs: Retrieve one or more KEGG database entries in a specified output format. Options include amino acid sequences, nucleotide sequences, molecular structure files, pathway images, KGML XML, and JSON.
